en_title: Haunted Chocolatier 'More of an Action RPG' Compared to Stardew Valley, ConcernedApe Says
cn_title: 《星露谷物语》作者称新作更偏动作RPG
subtitle: 献给喜欢下矿洞的玩家
opus_summary: 《星露谷物语》作者称，新作《Haunted Chocolatier》更偏动作RPG，侧重冒险、收集装备和提升实力。游戏尚未定档，他仍在反复打磨细节。

paragraphs.en: Eric Barone, aka ConcernedApe, has briefly discussed the difference between his all-conquering indie game Stardew Valley and his hotly anticipated follow-up, Haunted Chocolatier .
paragraphs.cn: 以ConcernedApe为名的Eric Barone简要谈到了两款作品的区别：一款是他大获成功的独立游戏《星露谷物语》，另一款则是备受期待的新作《Haunted Chocolatier》。

paragraphs.en: Barone announced Haunted Chocolatier back in 2021, but amid ongoing work on his phenomenally successful Stardew Valley, progress on the follow-up has been slow going. Indeed, in June, Barone admitted to feeling somewhat embarrassed to have to keep on saying he was still working away on the game. “Feels kinda dumb posting this same thing over and over, but that’s the reality,” he said at the time.
paragraphs.cn: Barone早在2021年就公布了《Haunted Chocolatier》，但他一直还在为大获成功的《星露谷物语》工作，新作的开发进展也因此较为缓慢。今年6月，Barone坦言，自己不得不反复告诉大家还在埋头开发这款游戏，这让他有些尴尬。他当时说：「一遍又一遍地发同样的内容，感觉有点傻，但事实就是如此。」

paragraphs.en: “It is still what I call a town game,” Barone said, “But it’s more of an action RPG — the main focus is more about adventuring, finding equipment and getting more powerful. There are monsters, there are boss fights. It's for the people in Stardew Valley that go into the mines. That's what I do, honestly.”
paragraphs.cn: Barone说：「它依然是我所说的小镇游戏，但更偏向动作RPG，主要侧重冒险、寻找装备，以及让自己变得更强。游戏里有怪物，也有Boss战。它是为那些在《星露谷物语》里喜欢下矿洞的玩家做的。说实话，我自己玩的时候也是这样。」

paragraphs.en: In June, Barone admitted fussing over every last detail in a bid to make Haunted Chocolatier as close to perfect as humanly possible . “I am being very thoughtful about every aspect of the game,” he said at the time. “The things in the game which the player will be interacting with or using very often need to be ‘perfect.’ They need to be seamless, clear, intuitive, satisfying, aesthetic.”
paragraphs.cn: 今年6月，Barone坦言，自己在每一个细节上都反复琢磨，力求在能力所及的范围内，让《Haunted Chocolatier》尽可能接近完美。他当时说：「游戏的每个方面，我都在认真考虑。玩家经常需要交互或使用的内容，必须做到「完美」。它们需要流畅、清晰、直观，既让人满意，又有美感。」

paragraphs.en: He used the example of iterating on the recipe book for making chocolates, which sounded like a significant challenge.
paragraphs.cn: 他以反复修改制作巧克力用的配方书为例，听起来这可不是个小挑战。

paragraphs.en: “To me, it’s not a simple task, as I torture myself over every last detail,” he said. “This is a UI you will be using fairly often, so it has to be perfect. You need to be able to accomplish your goal with the minimal number of clicks. There needs to be just the right amount of data presented to the player: not so much as to be overwhelming, but not so little as to be trivial or mundane. And the way that this data is laid out on the page is crucial… If the data is all clustered together, it will be disgusting to look at. The data needs to be grouped into compelling, intuitive and easy to read/understand groupings. It needs to look appealing and intriguing. And this is just the bare minimum, that players will likely take for granted. If all of that is accomplished then the player is now comfortable while perusing the recipe book. But I want more than just comfort. I want to delight the player. All of this typically requires me to iterate on something several times before I’m satisfied with it.”
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「对我来说，这不是个简单的任务，因为我会在每一个细节上折磨自己。这是你会经常使用的界面，所以它必须完美。你需要能以最少的点击次数完成目标。呈现给玩家的信息量必须恰到好处：不能多到让人无所适从，也不能少到显得无足轻重或平淡无趣。这些信息在页面上的排布方式也至关重要……如果全都挤在一起，看着就会令人反感。信息需要合理分组，既吸引人，又直观，还要易于阅读和理解。界面要看起来有吸引力，让人想进一步探索。而这些只是最基本的要求，玩家很可能会觉得理所当然。如果这些都做到了，玩家翻阅配方书时就能感到舒适。但我想要的不只是舒适。我想让玩家感到愉悦。要做到这一切，我通常得反复修改好几次，才能满意。」

paragraphs.en: Barone also explained why he didn't want to show Haunted Chocolatier off too much at this stage of development. “Partly, it feels like I’m serving a half-baked bread. I would rather serve a fully baked bread,” he said. “Also, I know that many parts of the game will likely evolve and change before release, so if I reveal them early, I risk disappointing players if the final product does not match their expectation. Fortunately, I’m in a position where I don’t need to market the game, so I can take my preferred approach.”
paragraphs.cn: Barone还解释了为什么他不想在目前这个开发阶段过多展示《Haunted Chocolatier》。他说：「部分原因是，这感觉像是在端出一个没烤熟的面包。我更愿意端出一个完全烤好的面包。另外，我知道游戏的许多部分在发售前很可能还会演变和调整。如果过早展示这些内容，而最终成品又不符合玩家的预期，就可能让他们失望。幸运的是，我目前不需要为游戏做营销，所以可以按自己喜欢的方式来。」

paragraphs.en: Haunted Chocolatier is so far without a release date, as is Stardew Valley 1.7 update, which Barone isn’t working on directly. Earlier this year, he explained his current way of working in an interview with IGN .
paragraphs.cn: 《Haunted Chocolatier》目前尚未公布发售日期，《星露谷物语》1.7更新也是如此，Barone目前并未直接参与这次更新的开发。今年早些时候，他在接受IGN采访时解释了自己目前的工作方式。

paragraphs.en: “Well, part of the reason why I've expanded my team a little bit is so that hopefully I can spend more time working on Haunted Chocolatier," he told us in February. "And it's worked out pretty well so far, I would say. On 1.7, the approach we're taking is that I am like, you might say the creative director and I'm involved with like, 'Okay, here's what we're going to do. Here's some of the ideas.' Then I let the team work on that. And then meanwhile, I'm working on Haunted Chocolatier.
paragraphs.cn: 他在2月告诉我们：「嗯，我稍微扩充了团队，部分原因就是希望能把更多时间用在《Haunted Chocolatier》上。我觉得，到目前为止效果还不错。开发1.7更新时，我们采用的方式是，我有点像创意总监，负责提出「好，我们接下来要做这些，这是一些想法」。然后我让团队去落实，与此同时，我则在开发《Haunted Chocolatier》。

paragraphs.en: "At some point in 1.7's cycle, I will get heavily involved, because I feel like my hand needs to touch every part of the game, every aspect of the update. I need to go over it and adjust it or at least approve everything. So it will require a lot of my time anyway, but I think the balance has been a little bit more shifted, so that I can spend more time focused on Haunted Chocolatier. And I think it's been working out pretty good. That's been a big change from the 1.3 update or 1.1 or something where it's completely me. I had no time to work on a new game. So that has changed.
paragraphs.cn: 「在1.7的开发周期中，到了某个阶段，我会深度参与，因为我觉得游戏的每个部分、更新的每个方面，都需要我亲自经手。我需要逐一检查并调整，至少也要逐一确认通过。所以它依然会占用我很多时间，但我觉得现在的时间分配稍微有了一些变化，让我能把更多时间集中在《Haunted Chocolatier》上。我觉得效果挺不错的。相比1.3、1.1之类的更新，这是个很大的变化，那时候完全是我一个人在做。我没有时间开发新游戏。现在这一点已经改变了。

paragraphs.en: "It is difficult because it's hard to shift gears, I guess. If I'm thinking about Haunted Chocolatier, it's difficult to be like, 'Okay, I'm going to one day of the week or two days of the week work on Stardew Valley.' That's not how my brain works. I'm all in one thing or the other. So I've been trying to work on that. I feel like it requires a lot of discipline, which I'm always working to improve on."
paragraphs.cn: 「这确实很难，我想是因为切换工作状态很难。如果我正想着《Haunted Chocolatier》，就很难告诉自己：「好，我每周要拿出一两天来做《星露谷物语》。」我的大脑不是这样运转的。我会全身心投入其中一件事。所以我一直在努力调整。我觉得这需要很强的自律，而我也一直在努力提高自己的自律能力。」

paragraphs.en: We interviewed ConcernedApe and chatted about topics such as the addition of two new marriage candidates with 1.7 , the one secret players still haven't found yet , and why there isn't a Stardew Valley TV show yet . We also chatted with the Stardew Valley community about what the game has meant to them over the years.
paragraphs.cn: 我们采访了ConcernedApe，聊到了1.7更新将新增两位可结婚对象、玩家至今仍未发现的一个秘密，以及为什么《星露谷物语》还没有改编成电视剧等话题。我们也与《星露谷物语》社区的玩家聊了聊，这些年来这款游戏对他们有怎样的意义。
